component.name: myDex
component.summary: Offline Pokémon encyclopedia for every game

description.p: myDex is a fast, private Pokémon encyclopedia that works completely offline. It opens on the International Pokédex – every Pokémon with its newest data – and switches to any game with one tap.

ul.li: Types, base stats, abilities, evolutions and moves per game
Locations and ways to obtain each Pokémon
Collection with shiny tracking and a cross-game checklist
Teams with validation, stat calculation and type analysis
No account, no ads, no tracking; optional self-hosted sync

description.p: Unofficial fan project. Pokémon and all related names are trademarks of their respective owners.
